answer.summary: All AppTest cases fail because the Spring context never starts: a circular bean dependency (workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService). The PR edits WorkflowEndService, NotificationEventService and the notification handlers, so the change likely introduced it. Failures are deterministic, not flaky, and a re-run should fail the same way.

evidence.quote: Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default.
